units.rawText: Perhaps it is easier to put it into words than keeping everything to myself.

spans.text: Perhaps it is easier to put it into words than keeping everything to myself.

units.rawText: Thank you, Professor. For listening to my feelings and the stories of my past.

units.rawText: I shall put the past behind me and move forward, for there is still a long road ahead of us.
